operating_notes.text: FY26 consolidated revenue split: ₹3,491 Cr within India and ₹272 Cr outside India.
Contingent liabilities at 31 March 2026 total ₹214 Cr, of which income-tax ₹158 Cr.
Related-party purchases of raw materials and components from SKF GmbH were ₹179 Cr in FY26.
Q1FY27 continuing operations revenue ₹587.79 Cr versus ₹594.54 Cr in Q4FY26, broadly flat QoQ after the demerger.
Q1FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,283.15 Cr included the industrial undertaking, which was demerged effective 1 October 2025 and is shown as discontinued operations.
The resulting company SKF India (Industrial) recognised stamp duty and land transfer premium of ₹1,639.2 million (₹163.9 Cr) on the demerged land parcels.
72,125 shareholders on the 7 August 2026 cut-off; 73 shareholders attended the AGM via VC (1 promoter, 72 public).
SKF India rebranded to SKF Vertevo, focusing on automotive solutions post-demerger
Company developing high-speed EV bearings capable of ~20,000 rpm with future focus on 30,000 rpm technology
Sustainability targets include complete decarbonization of manufacturing sites by 2030
Q1FY27 segment mix: OE 62%, VA 20%, Exports 8%, SKF Industrial 10%.
New PV wheel-end business win with a large passenger vehicle manufacturer, first with this customer, >95% localisation.
All three automotive plants (Bangalore, Haridwar, Pune) achieved >98% renewable energy sourcing and decarbonized status.
OEM mix: 2-wheeler 54%, passenger vehicle 31%, commercial vehicle 15% of OEM sales in Q1FY27
Export sales grew from 6% QoQ to 8% YoY in Q1FY27

timeline.summary: FY26 annual report shows a clean unmodified audit, contingent liabilities down to ₹214 Cr after a BAPA, and AGM resolutions seeking approval for up to ₹2,529 Cr of related-party transactions with SKF India (Industrial).
SKF India reported Q1FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹587.79 Cr (-54.2% YoY) and PAT of ₹61.92 Cr (-47.6% YoY), the first quarter reflecting the 1 Oct 2025 demerger of the industrial undertaking.
SKF India's 65th AGM on 14 August 2026 passed all eight resolutions, including a ₹40/share FY26 final dividend and material related-party transactions with SKF India (Industrial) and SKF GmbH.
SKF India Ltd’s 65th AGM on 14th August 2026 unanimously approved audited standalone financials for FY2026, with 100% votes in favor (40,613,452/49,437,963 shares).
SKF India rebranded to SKF Vertevo and completed demerger of industrial business, establishing pure-play automotive company
SKF India reported Q1FY27 revenue of ₹5,878 mn (+27.1% YoY) and EBITDA margin of 17.1%, and announced its first PV wheel-bearing business win with a large passenger vehicle manufacturer.
SKF India reported Q1FY27 revenue of ₹587.8 Cr (+27% YoY) and EBITDA margin; with management raising revenue growth guidance to ~20% from prior 12%.
